  use ⟨x c₁, fun y j => (hx c₁ y).1 j⟩
· intro c₁ m
  apply ConeMorphism.ext
  ext y
  exact (hx c₁ y).2 (m y) (fun j => ConeMorphism.w m j)

This should close the goal, using the existence and uniqueness provided by hx to construct the unique morphism.
